Rich people don't think the way you've been told to think.

Kevin Trudeau explains that when wealthy people were hooked up to brain monitors, their brains spent most of the time in two calm states, alpha and theta. They weren't stuck in the busy, analytical mode most of us live in all day.

He says the people who seem to manifest goals almost like magic share this pattern, especially when they are putting out a desire for something they want.

When did you last feel calm and sure about something you wanted?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Two or three flights of stairs, and no mouth breathing allowed.

Kevin Trudeau tells how his training group ran stairs breathing in and out through the nose only. They timed who broke down first, then tried again the next day.

Everyone improved, until they could keep it up for 20 or 30 minutes straight. Small daily practice built real ability.

What small thing could you practice every day until it gets easy?

#ad #habits #success #kevintrudeau

Your energy may arrive in a room before you do.

Kevin Trudeau says the brain is both a broadcaster and a receiver of frequency. What it puts out affects the physical world, and it is picked up by other people's brains too.

He says it can strongly influence their thoughts, feelings and actions. So the energy you carry matters.

What energy do you think people feel when you walk in?
